decisions.reason: As a flagship service very close to the firm’s core vessel-management capabilities and growth direction in offshore and renewable shipping, it is well within the knowledge base the firm can exploit and improve.
This service extends established crewing, administration, and client-support activities, so the firm can absorb feedback quickly and bundle it efficiently with its existing maritime offer.

Although more digital than the traditional service base, the portal builds on the firm’s existing vessel information flows and was presented as a focus area, which supports continued learning and commercial development.

The app is related to current operational know-how but needs stronger software and performance-analytics capabilities than the firm’s core service business, so it faces the highest review risk even though it still fits the broader offer.
